tagline: Three in a row, against the computer or a friend on the other side of the board.
description:
A three-by-three grid. One of you is X, the other is O. Take turns putting a mark down. First to get three in a line — across, down, or diagonal — wins.

Play the computer. It thinks on this device; there is no server. Play another person on the same screen, passing the device between you. Or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. X sits one side, O the other.

An unofficial port of Colyseus Tic-Tac-Toe. The original needs a game server. This copy does not: the meeting is the room.
